rules.identity: Current authenticated personal scope on every read, write and retry
rules.revision: Zero creates; every acknowledged mutation increments revision
rules.retry: Identical operation returns its retained result; changed payload conflicts
rules.pending: Unavailable authority or uncertain delivery retains the same operation
rules.ending: Fixed canonical scheduled end; due at end minus 30 minutes, strictly before end
rules.delivery: Transactional local outbox; receiver deduplicates notice_id and rechecks current source

response.through_revision: complete inclusive watermark, equal to requested revision
response.items: immutable canonical occurrences with event_id, watch_id, kind, revision, occurred_at, sample

source_occurrences.rules: Authenticated bounded retained activity read; no latest-snapshot inference. Incomplete, denied, stale or uncertain reads do not advance observation. No truncation with a complete watermark.

recovery.assignment: recovery_assignment(notice_id) returns responsible operator ID and escalation operator ID
recovery.authorization: authorize_recovery(actor, assigned_operator, notice_id) rechecks current scoped permission
recovery.rules: Fifth failed attempt atomically holds with named assignment and next action; response due in 24 hours; escalation at 48 hours without resolution. Reconciliation records response and permits at most five retries using the original notice. Stable operation receipts survive restart; stale and changed retries reject.
